connector.name: Convai Analytics
connector.registryDescription: Analyze Convai sessions, latency, reliability, usage, and provider telemetry via API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package analytics-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the conv-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CONVAI_API_KEY
env.description: Convai API key for the account to query.

env.name: CONVAI_ANALYTICS_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional analytics API base URL override.
